angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 591,783 km at 32.52 pc = 0.24 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 30.7532 +/- 0.0176 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 32.52 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.851 (0.833 to 0.868) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 591,783 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.900 (0.860 to 0.940) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5370 +/- 3.5 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5488567574038257280: teff_gspphot 5370.0527 K (16th-84th percentiles 5366.3633-5373.3), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5488567574038257280: teff_gspphot 5370.0527 K (16th-84th percentiles 5366.3633-5373.3), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/tapecue.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.533, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 63765 (pscomppars): spectral type G9 V, from Ségransan et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011A%26A...535A..54S/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 63765: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 63765 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.16 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 63765 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.25647, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 63765 (pscomppars): age 4.77 Gyr, from Ségransan et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011A%26A...535A..54S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 63765 (pscomppars): rotation period 23 d, from Ségransan et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011A%26A...535A..54S/abstract)

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 63765 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.63 km/s, from Ségransan et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011A%26A...535A..54S/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.851 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.871. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
